purpose: deterministic non-production visual-direction and provider-geometry preview for one adaptive action-bar rail

target.note: screen origins are physical pixels; provider frames are calculated in UI units, then multiplied by UI scale and the saved movable scale

accepted_neighbor.role: read-only current accepted/runtime neighbouring slot for layer-order and density judgement; never rail visual authority or production reference

locked_authority.image_1: assets/locked/character/角色属性面板_香草同构收敛_风格确认_v3.png
locked_authority.role: highest visual authority for vanilla hand-painted material relationship, palette, directional light and restrained wear; pixels are not copied into this simulation

rail_contract.runtime_layer: bar.backdrop or bar1.mergedBackdrop, below all slot backdrops and provider dynamic layers
rail_contract.source_mode: RGB with exact #00FF00 chroma outside the one object
rail_contract.semantics: one quiet square nine-slice master; deep walnut leather/wood core, narrow broken oxidized-brass outer edge, tiny corner fasteners, low-frequency stretch center
forbidden: fixed twelve-slot plate or any baked grid
icons, text, keybinds, counts, cooldowns or interaction states
large endcaps, gryphons, stone plinth, black glass slab, paper or purple quality glow
bright continuous metal bevel, modern PBR, micro-scratches or high-frequency grain

scene_base_annotations.subtitle: Rail 只承担最低层连续材质；动作槽、冷却、距离红、按下反馈和命中区保持现有 provider 所有权
scene_base_annotations.note: 本地确定性模拟 · 非 source / runtime · ImageGen 0/0
scene_base_annotations.rules_title: 本次需要确认的视觉方向
rules: 深胡桃褐皮革／木芯，暗黄铜仅作断续窄外缘
不画固定格线；任意合法行列只改变外轮廓
横栏、竖栏、多行栏保持同一视觉厚度
四角装饰停在最外 2 UI，不进入按钮区域
主栏／副栏满足 pfUI 条件时合并为一块无中缝背景

non_authoritative: all locally drawn rail pixels, simplified brush texture, seams, alpha and corner details
